verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs say instances launched through the Cloud API can use an alternative base image instead of the default Ubuntu + Lambda Stack, and can apply launch-time configuration via cloud-init. Together these let a developer shape the instance environment at launch. Nothing shows users can bring their own Docker image or upload and save a custom machine image or template, so the 'alternative' images appear to come from Lambda's own set. Missing for 10: bring-your-own Docker or container image support, user-created or saved custom machine images or templates, base-image selection in the console (not just the API), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment

citations.quote: If you launch your instance using the Lambda Cloud API, you can choose to use an alternative base image instead.
the API allows you to use a different base image for your instance
If you're launching your instance with the Lambda Cloud API, you can add launch-time configuration instructions using [cloud-init](https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).
